preset_safety: Choose a starting set, then review the selected permissions. Nothing is granted until you create the key. Canvas access is granted separately.
approval_scope: This page reviews requests made through the public MCP API. Managed tool proposals are reviewed inside their original canvas, with the exact destination and arguments. Approving one does not approve the other.
canvas_reviews: Open canvases for managed tool reviews
choose_content: Choose an article or page using Edit.
template_safety: Creates private cards only. Choose sources and a provider, grant access where needed, then review before running.
content_help: Saved content → instructions → private draft or review checklist.
evidence_help: Notes and sources → organized evidence for human review.
media_help: Prompt and sources → media candidate. Requires a configured media tool.
no_matching_canvas: No matching canvas in this list.
review_queue_help: These canvases have managed tool requests waiting for your review. Open run history to inspect the exact destination and arguments. Expired requests require a fresh run.
missing: A saved reference is unavailable. Review the bundle.
connection_pass: Last discovery passed · not a live status
